subject.title: feat(android): add Wear conversations, voice, agents, and sessions

question: Should OpenClaw first land the status-only Wear vertical slice in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108803, or sponsor this PR's full conversations/voice/sessions surface and mandatory release-archive integration now?
rationale: Both branches are viable but establish materially different product, security-review, and Android release commitments; repository evidence does not show an owner decision selecting the full rollout.

options.title: Land status first
options.body: Merge the smaller status bridge first, keep this PR as follow-up work, and add conversations, voice, and release publication in owner-approved stages.

options.title: Sponsor full Wear surface
options.body: Approve this complete scope after making audio opt-in and explicitly accepting the expanded release and security boundary.

options.title: Split runtime from release
options.body: Land the phone/watch conversation runtime separately while deferring mandatory release-archive and publication wiring to an owner-controlled PR.

recommendation.title: Land status first
recommendation.body: Merge the smaller status bridge first, keep this PR as follow-up work, and add conversations, voice, and release publication in owner-approved stages.

likelyOwner.reason: The Android README identifies @obviyus as the Android contribution owner, and the decision spans Android runtime, UX, and release coordination.
